found.title: About Us - Jimmy Baillie
found.summary: About page for founder/Managing Director Jimmy Baillie. States he founded Silver Oak Capital in 2019, advising on loans between GBP 500k and GBP 20m secured on assets throughout the UK and abroad, and that he graduated from the University of Cape Town in 2010 (BCom Honours, Economics). This is the on-domain link to Cape Town/South Africa.
verbatim: He founded Silver Oak Capital in 2019 – focussing on providing advice for loans between £500k – £20m, secured on assets throughout the UK and abroad.
Jimmy graduated from the University of Cape Town in 2010 with a BCom Honours Degree in Economics.
found.notes: Both sentences quoted by the search tool in query 8.
